scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && uv run --project backend ruff check backend && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && uv run --project backend mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && uv run --project backend pytest backend
scripts.licenses:check: node scripts/check-node-licenses.mjs && uv run --project backend python backend/scripts/check_licenses.py
